zh-CN.title: 从聊天打开我的名片
items: 新账户默认显示自己的聊天头像，保留已有显示偏好
点击自己消息旁的头像，即可查看我的名片并切换好友或陌生人视角

en.title: Your profile, right from chat
items: New accounts show their own chat avatar by default, while existing preferences are preserved
Tap your avatar beside a message to preview your profile as a friend or stranger
